title: "Vad kallt det är idag!" What Do You Answer? | Swedish Small Talk | SvenskaVardag
text:
A stranger at the bus stop says "Vad kallt det är idag!" 🥶 It's not a complaint, it's small talk. What do you answer? Write it in Swedish in the comments! ☀️

📝 "Vad kallt det är idag!"
↳ It's so cold today! (an invitation to chat)

🎓 Ja, verkligen! Det är iskallt. = Yes, really! It's freezing.
Men det ska bli sol i helgen! = But it's going to be sunny this weekend!

👉 Follow @svenskavardag for a little Swedish every day. Share this with a friend who is learning Swedish.
